sourceProof.selectedGroup: Only grupo is forwarded to group of #tag:references. English group is ignored. Explicit blank grupo selects the default group.
sourceProof.heading: nível then positional3 suppresses the heading only when0. Otherwise título then positional1 selects heading text, default Referências, and nível then positional2 selects level, default2.
sourceProof.extraAndLayout: extra is displayed. estilo/5 and estilolista affect wrapper style. These fields cannot be flattened into group-only identity.

authorityLimits: This is the literal primary source interface, not a new whole-render-equivalence contract.
Implicit MediaWiki default-reference rendering does not authorize deletion or relocation of an explicit headed collector.
Consumed grupo/heading/layout/count/order are distinct from ignored English group.
Only independently fresh existing source plans may authorize declared collector removal/heading repair. Candidate text is never used as expected baseline.
testLimits: Actual transformations and source-preservation endpoint cases are separate from guard-only candidate mutations.
The exact generated-style removal uses its independently declared native layout repair plan and fresh source-bound proof.
No target normalization, collector-group-only equivalence, implicit default renderer, or altered bank/body waiver is authorized.

intendedGroupRepair.classification: Existing invalid supplied-key repair, not native equivalence.
intendedGroupRepair.sourceRole: The pinned native Referências consumes grupo and ignores group.
intendedGroupRepair.authority: Existing v212CollectorGroups / exact identical duplicate transaction, now requires a complete explicit same-group source ref or pinned native note body.
intendedGroupRepair.defaultCollector: If any common-group or opaque/dynamic emitter may depend on the source default collector, another valid unconditional native default collector must remain. No implicit automatic list is assumed.
intendedGroupRepair.localAliases: Exact native Listaref/Références header forwarding may compose this independent repair with the same complete-source proof. It does not inherit a foreign group role.
intendedGroupRepair.refusal: Missing or differing emission, blank/native competing group priority, unknown owner, original header controls, disabled scope preserve the supplied group field. Other independently permitted header forwarding retains all argument bytes.

retainedDeclaredRepairEvidence.canonicalPositiveFields: Referências/referências with one group=nota field, optional ASCII padding, and exact complete <ref group="nota">Nota.</ref> in the same source.
retainedDeclaredRepairEvidence.classification: Existing declared intended supplied-key repair with explicit source-group intent, not foreign role inheritance or native render equivalence.
